title: Product Owner Customer Onboarding & KYC (f/m/d)
description:
Our digital bank is hiring a Product Owner for customer onboarding. You will improve identity verification, account opening and re-verification flows that serve customers in German.

What you'll do
- Own the backlog for onboarding and KYC journeys
- Work with compliance and operations on regulatory changes
- Measure drop-off and test improvements with the analytics team

What you bring
- 3+ years as Product Owner in banking or fintech
- Experience with KYC, AML or identity verification
- Fluent German at C1 level is mandatory, since customer flows and legal texts are in German
- Very good English
